name: Week 18 KB Saturday Cardio — Conditioning (Spotlight: Swing Clean; High-Rep Finisher)
description: Saturday KB OPTION — pure conditioning, distinct from Tue (flow + AMRAP) and Thu (lighter skill template). Light bell throughout (16-20lb) — breathing rate and sustainability are the targets, not load. Deliberately compact so it stays a clean skip when the week's been heavy: the Asgooch cardio complex carries over, then the finisher rotates this week to a high-rep descending ladder (swing → around-body pass → goblet squat → high pull). Spotlight rotates to the swing clean — the rack catch. Optional light push-press ladder if you want a strength touch (it worked great W17). Choice-of-the-day on D6 alongside stairmaster, easy run, or rest.

dayOverview.theme: Saturday conditioning — light bell, breathing-rate target. Kept compact: Asgooch cardio complex + a high-rep descending-ladder finisher (rotated from W17's controlled-power) — so it's a clean skip on a heavy week and doesn't bleed into a strong Monday. Day after Friday legs — squatting stays LIGHT on purpose. Spotlight rotates to the swing clean. Optional light push-press ladder available.

spotlights.why: Rotates in as this week's spotlight (W17 was the snatch). The swing clean is the rack catch that sets up half the complex — spotlight the hip drive into the rack and the soft, knees-absorb catch so the bell settles clean instead of banging the forearm. The cleaner the clean, the smoother the whole cardio complex flows.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: Finisher rotates: W16 100-rep block · W17 controlled-power · W18 high-rep descending ladder (current) · W19 cycle forward — a fresh complex. Spotlight rotates: W17 snatch · W18 swing clean · W19 front squat or high pull. The Asgooch cardio complex stays; the finisher + spotlight rotate so Saturday stays fresh.
watchpoints: **Saturday is optional and deliberately compact** — keep it a clean skip when the week's been heavy. The point is to not over-train into a weak Monday; weekends stay light.
**Day after Friday legs.** Squatting (front squat × 6 in the complex; the finisher goblet squat) stays LIGHT — 16-20lb. Skip the squat reps if the QL/quads are talking.
**Light bell is the whole point** — 16-20lb working. Conditioning means breathing rate, not bell weight.
**Asgooch CARDIO complex ≠ Tuesday's work** — row/clean/squat/snatch, low-and-explosive.
**Swing-clean spotlight** — hip drive into the rack, soft knees-absorb catch, no forearm bang.
**Finisher rotated to a high-rep descending ladder** — swing 50 → around-body pass 40 → goblet squat 30 → high pull 20. Light bell, break the reps into chunks if needed; keep moving.

**OPTIONAL light push-press ladder** — you did 40/45/50 × 8/7/6 here W17 and it 'worked great.' If you want a strength touch, run it after the warm-up (clean to rack, dip-drive, pack the shoulder down). Keep it light and optional — Saturday's still a conditioning day.
**Choice-of-the-day on D6** — not mandatory. Skip if Friday legs cooked you; swap for stairmaster / easy run if cardio-only is the call. No pull-up greasing here — Saturday is the conditioning flank.

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 16-20lb. Loosen the shoulders fast — the cardio complex is its own warmup.
Easy two-handed swings. Prime the hinge.
Light, open the hips. Skip if Friday legs left the quads sore.
Standing, torso hinged slightly forward. Wakes the grip + forearm + posterior chain — primes the clean catch.

**LOAD:** 18lb. Your bottoms-up shoulder warmup — bell inverted/balanced over a vertical forearm, hard grip, shoulder packed. **8/side in two planes:** forward press (straight overhead) + T-press (press out toward a T at shoulder height). Fires the rotator cuff and primes the right shoulder before the overhead work.

sets.name: 🔆 Asgooch Cardio Complex — LEFT (Spotlight: Swing Clean)

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 16-20lb. Left hand. Hips back, back flat, pull the elbow past the ribs. 2s pull, 2s lower.

Left hand. 🔆 **SPOTLIGHT — the rack catch:**
- **Hip drive into the rack** — the hinge throws the bell up, the arm just guides it; thumb toward the collarbone
- **Soft catch — knees absorb, elbow tucks to the ribs** — the bell settles into the rack, it doesn't bang the forearm
- **Ribs down at the rack** — stacked, not leaning back
- **Right shoulder watch on the catch** — keep it packed; lighten if it crackles
Left rack. **LIGHT** — Friday legs is yesterday. Sit tall, full depth IF the legs are fresh; reduce depth before load if they're cooked.
Left hand. Hips drive the bell, punch the hand THROUGH at the top for a soft catch, no bang. **Right shoulder watch** — sub high pulls for the last 2 rounds if it crackles on the catch.

sets.notes: 5 rounds LEFT. Continuous within a round — row → clean → squat → snatch with no rest. Rest 30-45s between rounds. **Weak side first.**

sets.name: Asgooch Cardio Complex — RIGHT

exercises.notes: Right hand. Same form — hips back, full extension.
Right hand. **Spotlight rack catch** — hip drive, soft knees-absorb catch, no forearm bang.
Right rack. Same depth/load discipline as the left.
Right hand. Punch-through + right shoulder watchpoint on the catch — same modify-to-high-pull rule.

sets.notes: 5 rounds RIGHT. Continuous within a round. **If the workout is running long after the left side, drop to 3-4 rounds right — don't grind a quality session into a sloppy one.**

sets.name: 🪜 High-Rep Descending Ladder — Light & Moving (Rotated In for W18)

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 16-20lb. Two-handed swings — snap the hips, float to chest height, arms are ropes. Break into chunks (e.g. 2×25) and keep the breathing rate up. **Hand-eye option:** run a chunk as hand-to-hand swings (release + catch with the other hand at the float point) for coordination practice.
Smooth circles around the body, alternate direction halfway. Core tight, torso quiet — active recovery between the ballistic moves.
Full depth, chest up — **LIGHT**, Friday legs is yesterday. Skip or halve if the quads are tight; smooth controlled tempo, not a burnout.
Explosive hip snap, pull the bell to chin height, elbows high, controlled lower. **Right shoulder watch** — keep it light; the hip snap does the work, not the arm.

sets.notes: **High-rep descending ladder — 50 → 40 → 30 → 20.** One pass through the four: swing → pass → goblet squat → high pull. Light bell, break each into chunks if needed, rest ~30s between moves. Posture + breathing-rate focus, not max effort. (Rotated in from W17's controlled-power finisher.)

tips: **Saturday conditioning option — choice-of-the-day on D6.** Alternates with stairmaster, easy run, or rest. Skip if Friday legs cooked you; deliberately compact so skipping it costs nothing.
**LIGHT bell throughout: 16-20lb working.** This is the whole point. Conditioning = breathing rate, not load.
**Core block carries over:** the Asgooch CARDIO complex (row/clean/squat/snatch × 6 × 5 rounds per side).
**Finisher rotated to a high-rep descending ladder** — swing 50 → pass 40 → goblet squat 30 → high pull 20, light bell, chunk the reps.
**Spotlight rotates to the swing clean** — hip drive into the rack, soft knees-absorb catch, no forearm bang.

**OPTIONAL light push-press ladder** — you ran 40/45/50 × 8/7/6 here W17 and it 'worked great.' Add it after the warm-up if you want a strength touch; keep it light, run the full banded prep if you do.
**Squatting stays LIGHT** — Friday legs is yesterday. Skip the squat reps if the quads are tight.
**Right shoulder watch on the clean / snatch / high pull** — light bell, smooth catch; high pulls if it crackles.
**No pull-up greasing here** — Saturday is the conditioning flank.
Rotation plan: W19 rotates the finisher to a fresh complex + the spotlight to the front squat or high pull.
formPhilosophy: Saturday is conditioning, distinct from the Tue and Thu KB days. Light bell, more reps. Kept deliberately compact — the Asgooch complex plus a rotating finisher (this week a high-rep descending ladder) — so it's a genuine choice, not an obligation: easy to skip on a heavy week, and light enough it never bleeds into a weak Monday. The optional push-press ladder is there because the user liked it W17, but it stays optional so Saturday's identity as the light conditioning flank holds. Building decades, not weeks.
